title: Square the racked gantry against both end stops
instruction: Move the gantry's two carriages along their rails until both rest square against their end stops, then let go.
context: A small Cartesian gantry starts racked on two captured guides. Squaring its linked ends is a printer/robot-building adjustment; this task isolates the mechanical step.
setup: Two250mm rails340mm apart support a20x20x400mm beam with two45.4x27x10mm captured lip carriages and a toolhead. Mounted carriage height13mm.0.8kg total estimated mass;0.25mm running clearances. Two initial rack angles/positions. All movement and retention use native physical contact. Steel proxy tracks spanx0.030–0.280 at y±0.170: foot12x3mm,z0–3;neck8x2mm,z3–5;head12x3mm,z5–8. Acetal block sidewalls:y±6.25–13.5mm,z3–13;top:z8.25–13;retaininglips:y±4.25–6.25mm,z3.25–4.75. Aluminium beam centrez23mm.40x50x40mm steeltoolhead at beam-local(30,0,10)mm. Steelstops10x30x20mm at(0.285,±0.170,table+0.010), stopplanesx0.280. BeamA:(0.216,0,table+0.023),yaw−0.45deg;B:(0.205,0,table+0.023),yaw+0.45deg. Exact manufactured profile and fixing recipe in README; native collision omits screws/beam hollows.
scoring: End-state score0.25 for >=25mm net engaged sliding at both ends, with valid final engagement and <=2mm offrail travel;0.5 also both faces within5mm of stops;0.75 all front corners within0.05mm and no more than0.10mm past stop planes, correct height/lateral registration;1 also all hands clear>5mm and beam still1s. Unknown physical state scores0. Sampled simulator finger loads separately flag feasibility; not a whole-trial force certificate. Physical counterpart uses video, ruler/caliper,0.05mm feeler and dial indicator. Trial1=A, trial2=B; report their mean. Every positive tier requires centres within0.6mm of rail centrelines, all top corners within1mm of seated height, yaw/upright tilt<=0.7deg, rear edges no more than0.5mm behind rail starts and front corners no more than0.10mm past stops.
run_limit: 1200control steps (60seconds at20Hz) per lot; both lots.
fidelity: MGN12H-family envelope at true size. Rectangular groove/lips approximate bearing capture; balls, preload, motors/belts absent.0.25mm clearance,0.8kg mass,0.2friction, toolhead and groove are estimates. Native contact gives capture/racking; no kinematic square rule. Physical fixture uses the stated sliding profile. Compound inertia estimated from collision volumes, not measured material distribution.
scores: Native scripted expert: A=1.0, B=1.0 (mean1.0;15.60/15.65s). Dream-1: A=0, B=0 (mean0;1200-step limits). Matching source/instruction, object_jitter=0, two epochs. Sampled expert finger peaks13.624/13.285N; no hardware result.
reset_notes: Slide the captured blocks back to beamA(x0.216,y0,ztable+0.023,yaw−0.45deg) orB(x0.205,y0,ztable+0.023,yaw+0.45deg), allowing0.25mmsettling. Rails remainx0.030–0.280,y±0.170; stops rearplanesx0.280. Verify both lips under railheads and specified0.25mm running gaps; use clean dry steel/acetal. No fixture/body is teleported during control.
